description: This file defines the Shipping controller for the Opencart admin panel extension. It manages the display and saving of shipping-related settings in the admin interface, including rendering the view with breadcrumbs, headers, and footer, and saving configuration changes via AJAX.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping total extension settings in Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the shipping extension settings page, including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX request to save shipping total extension settings, including permission check and JSON response.
